newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 fertiliser demand seen at 142 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China '97 fertiliser demand seen at 142 mln tonnes.

text.p: China's demand for fertiliser is expected to be about 142 million tonnes in 1997, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
Domestic annual production capacity for fertiliser was about 122 million tonnes, the official newspaper said.
The domestic market for farm materials would be basically stable in 1997, with a possible slight rise in demand, it said.
Domestic supply of pesticides could meet domestic demand, estimated at about 230,000 tonnes, it said but did not give further details.
